scope: Actual exported mesh quality for all 61 available machines, scoped native motion/reference and loaded combination reviews. Nine new native motion registrations cover 900 sampled poses. interaction_review.scope: Draft selection, atomic apply, cancel, retry and undo. Model catalogs, geometry, resolver and motion adapters are unchanged; 52 prior scoped native reviews are retained. belt_winding_review.scope: V2.4 and Monolith swept belt face orientation and signed volume at moving poses. Source belt omissions and physical tension are not certified.
